reserves.name: Colombian-peso cash deposited in a Colombian bank account

sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wCOP - June 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The June 30, 2026 certification reconciles 196,398,754 outstanding wCOP across seven chains to COP212,085,195.86 in a Colombian bank account and certifies full local-currency backing. Pablo Eduardo Soto signed the certification on July 28, 2026 for SLD y Asociados S.A. The engagement expressly does not constitute an audit or review and expresses no professional opinion. The bank and account terms remain undisclosed. The official wFIAT attestation index serves this report as its latest wCOP evidence on September 30, 2026; the 92-day-old balance date remains outside the live adapter's 33-day freshness ceiling.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent public accountant certification of wCOP collateral as of June 30, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; the Colombian financial institution, account type, and withdrawal liquidity are undisclosed.
